purpose: Fresh U3 meaning reserve frozen after the fifth-reserve recipient and budget-bound repairs. Mark exposed after first generation.
evaluationOrder: Freeze corpus and semantic criteria before production request export and on-device generation. Review meaning separately from policy readiness.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: The reviewed draft preserves every supplied recipient, state, correction, condition, qualifier, amount, unit, literal, and timing relationship. A source-free transformation is rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: A changed or missing recipient, status, corrected value, negation, condition, number, unit, literal, timezone, or action state; invented completion or send claim; unsupported content reaching review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Tone, punctuation, or formatting difference without a meaning change.
semanticCriteria.gate: Zero critical meaning errors and zero literal violations across these 16 cases. Record safe missing-source rejection separately from successful drafting.
